tools.name: bc_connection_check
tools.description: Comprueba la autenticación delegada contra el MCP nativo de Business Central y recupera su catálogo real de herramientas. No consulta clientes ni ejecuta las herramientas descubiertas. Devuelve entorno, empresa y configuración utilizados.

tools.name: List_Items_PAG30008
tools.title: List Items
tools.description: Consulta registros de artículos en Business Central. Solo lectura, sin crear, modificar ni eliminar registros. No uses inventory para filtrar ni ordenar. Available fields: id [string/uuid], number [string], displayName [string], displayName2 [string], type [string ['Inventory', 'Service', 'Non-Inventory']], itemCategoryId [string/uuid], itemCategoryCode [string], blocked [boolean], gtin [string], inventory [number/decimal], unitPrice [number/decimal], priceIncludesTax [boolean], unitCost [number/decimal], taxGroupId [string/uuid], taxGroupCode [string], baseUnitOfMeasureId [string/uuid], baseUnitOfMeasureCode [string], generalProductPostingGroupId [string/uuid], generalProductPostingGroupCode [string], inventoryPostingGroupId [string/uuid], inventoryPostingGroupCode [string], lastModifiedDateTime [string/date-time] (22 total). All fields can be used in select. Non-filterable fields cannot be used in filter and orderby. Non-filterable/non-sortable fields: inventory.

filter.description: OData V4.0 filter. Supported Operators: eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, and, or. Functions: contains, startswith, endswith, tolower, toupper. Use tolower() for case-insensitive: contains(tolower(field),'text'). 'or' ONLY works on the same field; use 'and' across fields. 'not' is unsupported; for simple inequality, use 'ne'. Avoid negating expressions or compound predicates. No arithmetic, no length/month/year/cast/concat. See the tool description for filterable properties and their types. Non-filterable fields are not filterable (see x-non-filterable extension).

orderby.description: OData V4.0 orderby (e.g. 'property asc', 'property1 desc, property2'). See the tool description for sortable properties. Non-filterable fields are not sortable (see x-non-filterable extension).

select.description: Lista de campos separados por comas, sin prefijo select= ni $. Ejemplo: number,displayName. Los campos disponibles se indican en la descripción de la herramienta.

top.description: Máximo de registros: 1 a 100; predeterminado 10. Pagina explícitamente con skip.

skip.description: Number of records to skip before returning results. Use with $top for pagination.

resultFormat.description: Esta versión devuelve resultados inline en formato text. No publica lectura de recursos remotos.

tools.name: List_Customers_PAG30009
tools.title: List Customers
tools.description: Consulta registros de clientes en Business Central. Solo lectura, sin crear, modificar ni eliminar registros. balanceDue es un saldo agregado; no acredita por sí solo deuda vencida. No asumas una divisa si no aparece en la respuesta. Available fields: id [string/uuid], number [string], displayName [string], type [string ['Company', 'Person']], addressLine1 [string], addressLine2 [string], city [string], state [string], country [string], postalCode [string], phoneNumber [string], email [string], website [string], salespersonCode [string], balanceDue [number/decimal], creditLimit [number/decimal], taxLiable [boolean], taxAreaId [string/uuid], taxAreaDisplayName [string], taxRegistrationNumber [string], currencyId [string/uuid], currencyCode [string], paymentTermsId [string/uuid], shipmentMethodId [string/uuid], paymentMethodId [string/uuid], blocked [string [' ', 'Ship', 'Invoice', 'All']], lastModifiedDateTime [string/date-time] (27 total). All fields can be used in select. Non-filterable fields cannot be used in filter and orderby. Non-filterable/non-sortable fields: taxAreaDisplayName, taxRegistrationNumber, currencyCode.
